education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public.

IS : 10938 -1984 




Indian Standard 

SPECIFICATION FOR 

SEARCHER, DOUBLE EDGED WITH 

HANDLE AND SHEATH 



( Reaffirmed 2006 ) 



1. Scope — Covers requirements for double edged searcher with handle and sheath, used in veterinary 
surgery. 



2. Shape and Dimensions — As shown in Fig. 1 . 



-SEMI SHARP EDGE 

-U 



tr. 



AO 



-0*75 min. 




SECTION YY 



All dimensions in millimetres. 
FIG. 1 SEARCHER, DOUBLE EDGED 

2.1 The deviations shall conform to coarse class of 18:2102-1969 'Specification for allowable 
deviations for dimensions without specified tolerances {first revision )'. 



3. Materials 
Searcher 

Handle 

Sheatli 

Thread 



Stainless steel conforming to Designation 40Crl3 of IS : 6603-1972 
'Specification for stainless steel bars and flats' 

Suitable aluminium or plastics {see IS : 2543-1964 Specification for 
cellulose acetate moulding and extrusion materials) 

Leather harness cow as per IS : 580-1973 'Specification for harness 
leather ( second revision )' 

Variety No. 5, 14 or 19 of IS : 1720-1979 'Specification for cotton 
sewing threads {second revision)' 

4. Requirements — The surface of the searcher shall be smooth and free from pits, burrs, cracks and 
other surface defects. The cutting edge shall be sharp, polished bright and passivated. The sheath 
shall be soundly constructed and finished smooth. There shall not be any loose thread and uneven 
seam. 

5. Hardness — The blade shall have a hardness of 600 HV, Min, determined in accordance with 
IS : 1501-1968 'Method for vickers hardness test for steel ( first revision )'. 



Adopted 27 June 1984

IS : 10938 -1984 

6. Tests — A 19 mm wire nail shall be hammered on a block of teak wood to a depth of 14 mm. The 
head of the nails shall then be levered by the working ends of the searcher and the nails pulled out 
from the wood. The searcher shall do the job easily and on completion of the test, the searcher shall 
show no sign of damage. 

6.1 Corrosion Res/stance Test — Shall conform to IS : 7531-1975 'Method for boiling and autoclaving 
test for corrosion resistance of stainless steel surgical instruments'. 

7. Marking — The searcher shall be clearly and indelibly marked, preferably by etching, with the 
manufacturer's name, initials or registered trade-mark. Each searcher shall also be marked with the 
word 'Stainless Steel' or letters 'SS'. 

7.1 IS/ Certification /\/!arking — Details available with the Indian Standards Institution. 

8. Packing — The searcher may be packed as agreed to between the purchaser and the supplier. 



Printed at Printrade, New Delhi, India
